## Invoice-Lines NIGHTLY (02:00)
Re-syncs the last `windowDays` (35) days: fetch -> **DELETE the window** -> insert.

**The delete is not optional and must not be swapped for a plain upsert.**
A cancelled invoice DISAPPEARS from `account.invoice.report`. An upsert would never
remove its stale row, so revenue would be overstated forever, and silently.

**Two safeguards around that delete:**
1. It runs AFTER the Odoo fetch, so a failed fetch stops the run before deleting.
2. `Has Rows?` skips the delete entirely when the fetch came back empty. 35 days with
   genuinely zero invoices is far less likely than a silent Odoo failure, and wiping the
   window on that basis would destroy real data.

`account.invoice.report` has no write_date, so edits to invoices OLDER than the window
are not caught here - re-run the full BACKFILL monthly to reset drift.

Leave INACTIVE until one product has been verified against Odoo.
